messages:
alyssa_cs: Quick regional rollup for VellumCo (private VPC). tl;dr — eu-west-1 seeing KMS decrypt failures, ap-southeast-1 tail latency up ~40ms, us-east-1 green. posting details below.

kms-monitor-bot: [ALERT] 15 KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE in eu-west-1 in last 10m. Keys impacted: 8 distinct ARNs. See alert: https://monitoring.internal/redwood/alerts/8427 :rotating_light:

mike_sre: Copy. Any signs of network packet loss from customer side? I ran a quick traceroute to their edge and saw spikes at the NAT hop.

raj_platform: Confirmed transient NAT gateway 504 spikes in eu-west-1 between 21:14-21:22 UTC. Example log: `NAT->upstream 10.0.3.12 504 timeout`. Possibly correlated with vendor maintenance window.

sophia_pm: Customer reported ~5% of requests failing around 21:20. App logs show KMS error: `AccessDenied` on decrypt for ARN arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:222:key/xxxxx. They say no IAM changes on their side.

alyssa_cs: They use custom KMS ARNs. Did we rotate any keys or change aliases last night?

raj_platform: No rotation from our end. HSM provider had a maintenance window 21:00-21:10 but they claimed no impact. I've opened vendor ticket HSM-8427 and flagged as P2.

mike_sre: I'll implement a short-lived mitigation: serve reads using cached DEK for 1h when decrypt fails and route new requests to us-east as fallback. Minimizes customer visible errors.

alyssa_cs: Please coordinate with eng and notify the customer (status page + slack). They care about data integrity and timeline.

raj_platform: Route policy applied: `prefer-region=us-east-1` for org `vellumco` TTL=3600. Command used: `rctl route update --org vellumco --policy prefer-region=us-east-1 --ttl 3600`

sophia_pm: Customer accepts fallback. Asking for ETA on full resolution and confirmation that no data lost.

mike_sre: ETA ~45 mins to get vendor confirmation + run end-to-end decrypt checks across all impacted key ARNs. Will post test matrix when done.

alyssa_cs: Noting this in renewal-risk tracker: temporary eu-west-1 degradation + KMS hiccup. Follow-up required before renewal touchpoint. cc @finance for potential spend blip due to cross-region routing.

monitor-bot: Region rollup report uploaded -> s3://reports/vellumco/rollups/1769504321-vellumco-rollup.csv

alyssa_cs: Thanks team. Next steps: mike & raj to validate vendor fix and confirm decrypt success for all keys by +1h, sophia to update customer. I'll keep renewal risk flag open until next check-in. :white_check_mark:
